sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The force result, both method operands, shapeCoefficient, and loadPatchAspectRatio are globally mandatory on every nltl:ship, so non-PC6/PC7 ships or ships without bulbous bows cannot pass despite the requirement being conditional. Keep polarClass and bulbousBowPresent as applicability inputs, but make the result and all declared operands conditional on (PC6 or PC7) AND bulbousBowPresent=true, using SHACL Core alternatives/branching or equivalent portable constraints. Preserve the existing kN/MN conversion, expected-result-scaled bounded tolerance, not-less-than comparison, and exact 0.6/1.3 operand bounds.
